title: LAP4 now separates 30 Base, 30 Reliable, 30 Diamond, D&D, TDC, and WECF scope objects
summary: The LANL work breakdown distinguishes the LAP4 umbrella from 30 Base Equipment Installation, 30 Reliable Equipment Installation, later 30 Diamond scope, Decontamination and Demolition, Training and Development Center, and West Entry Control Facility objects.
